card.name: Verb slot before dispensed or prescribed
card.fires_on: Small helping verbs like is, are or may right after a drug or pharmacy subject, where the next word is likely 'dispensed', 'distributed' or 'prescribed'. Seen in REMS and opioid Medication Guide wording.

modes.label: Drug is dispensed
modes.description: The word 'is' after 'every time an opioid analgesic', just before 'dispensed to them'.
modes.example: receive from their pharmacist every time an opioid analgesic<< is>> dispensed to them. • Consider using

modes.label: Pharmacies may distribute
modes.description: A helping verb after certified pharmacies in a restricted-distribution program, before a verb of supplying.
modes.example: only certified pharmacies<< may>> distribute phentermine and topiramate

modes.label: Medications are prescribed
modes.description: The word 'are' after 'these medications' in counseling advice, before 'prescribed'.
modes.example: every time these medications<< are>> prescribed. The Patient Counseling Guide (PC
